mapper.insert: insert into study ( leader_id, title, description, category_id, max_member, thumbnail )values( #{leaderId}, #{studyDTO.title}, #{studyDTO.description}, #{studyDTO.categoryId}, #{studyDTO.maxMember}, #{studyDTO.thumbnail} )
mapper.select: select * from study where study_status = 'RECRUITING' order by created_at desc
mapper.update: update study set title = #{title}, description = #{description}, category_id = #{categoryId}, max_member = #{maxMember}, thumbnail = #{thumbnail}, study_status = #{studyStatus} where study_id = #{studyId}
update study set study_status = 'ENDED' ended_at = current_timestamp where study_id = #{studyId}
mapper.select: select count(*) from study where study_status = 'RECRUITING'

select s.* from study s join study_member sm on s.study_id = sm.study_id where sm.member_id = #{memberId} and sm.member_status = 'ACTIVE' order by case when s.study_status in ('RECRUITING', 'CLOSED') then 0 when s.study_status = 'ENDED' then 1 end, s.created_at desc
select count(*) from study s join study_member sm on s.study_id = sm.study_id where sm.member_id = #{memberId} and sm.member_status = 'ACTIVE'
